BiblicalUsage: Shilhi is the father of Azubah, the mother of Jehoshaphat. His name is given twice, once in the reign of Jehoshaphat's father and once in his own.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a grandfather's name in a king's record is God's way of saying the family mattered. I hold that Jehoshaphat's godliness has a father-in-law behind it, and Shilhi is that man.
RelatedEvents: Jehoshaphat's Victory by Prayer and Praise
